dhp360:4:
saṁvaro → cakṣuṣā saṁvaro sādhu sādhu śrotreṇa saṁvaraඃ 
kāyena saṁvaro sādhu manasā sādhu saṁvaraඃ 
sarvatra saṁvṛto bhikṣuඃ sarvaduඃkhāt pramucyate (bj: mahāvastu 3. piṭa. 423)
dhp361:6:
pamuccati → kaena sañamu sadhu sadhu vayai sañamu. 
manena sañamu sadhu sadhu savatra sañamu. 
savatra sañato bhikhu sava dugatio jahi (bj: prā. dha. B . 9)
dhp362:4:
bhikkhuṁ → hatasañatu padasañatu vayasañatu savutidrīo 
ajhatmarato samahito eko satusito tamahu bhikhu (bj: prā. dha. B. 10)
dhp363:4:
bhāsitaṁ → yo muhena sañato bhikhu matabhati anudhato 
arthadharmu ji deseti mayuru tasa hasita (bj: prā. dha B. 11)
dhp364:4:
parihāyati → dharmārāmo dharmarato dharmamanuvicittayan 
dharmaṁ samanusamaran bhikṣuඃ saddharmānna parihāyati (bj: mahāvastu. 3. pi. 421)
dhp365:4:
nādhigacchati → salabhu tatimañe a nañeṣa savihao sia. 
añeṣa saddhamiha bhikhu samadhi nādhikajatī (bj: prā. dha. B . 20)
dhp367:4:
vuccati → savasu namaruvasa yasa nathi mamaita
asata i na śoyati so hu hikhu tu vucati (bj: prā. dha. B . 38)
dhp368:4:
sukhaṁ → maitrīvihāri yo bhikṣuඃ prasanno buddhaśāsane 
adhigacchati padaṁ śāntaṁ aśecanaṁ ca mocanam (bj: mahāvastu 3. 421); metra vihāra ye bhikkhu prasanu budha śasa......... 
paḍivindhu pada śata sagharavośamu subha (bj: prā. dha. B . 29)
dhp369:4:
nibbānamehisi → nibbāṇamehisi (bj) | nibbāṇamehisi → siṁca bhikṣo imāṁ nāvaṁ siktā te lahumeṣyati. 
jitvā rāgaṁ ca dveṣaṁ ca tato nirvāṇameṣyasi (bj: mahāvastu 3. 421); sija bhikhu ima nama sita tī lahu mesitī 
chetva raka ji dośa tato nivana eśiti (bj: prā. dha. B . 35)
dhp370:2: cuttari → uttari (sya-all) | cuttari bhāvaye pañca saṅgātigo → vuttaribhāvaye pañcasaṅgātigo (pts)
dhp370:4:
vuccati → paja jina paja jahi paja utvari bhavai 
paja sagadhio bhikhu ohatino’ti vacati (bj: prā. dha. B . 37)
dhp371:1: mā → mā ca (bj, sya-all) | pamādo → ca pāmado (pts) | bhikkhu → jhāya tuvaṁ bhikkhu (cck: ?) | pamādo → mā ca pamādo (cck: sī. syā. pī.)
dhp371:2: ramessu → bhavassu (sya-all); bhamassu (pts) | ramessu → bhamassu (cck: sī. pī.); bhavassu (cck: syā.); ramassu (cck: ka.)
dhp371:4:
dayhamāno → ḍayhamāno (bj, cck, sya-all) | ḍayhamāno → jai bhikhu ma yi pramadi ma te kamaguṇa bhameṁsu cittaṁ 
ma lohaguḍa gili pramata kana dukhamidati dajhamano (bj: prā. dha. B . 34)
dhp372:4:
nibbānasantike → nibbāṇasantike (bj) | nibbāṇasantike → nathi jhana aprañasa praña nathi ajhayato 
yasa jhana ca praña ya so ho nirvanasa sati a (bj: prā. dha. B . 16)
dhp373:4:
vipassato → suñakare praviṭhasa śatavitasa bhikhuno 
amanuṣa rati hoti sajama dharma vivaśatu (bj: prā. dha. B . 12)
dhp374:3: pītipāmojjaṁ → pītipāmojjajaṁ (bj) | Labhatī → labhati (cck: pī.); labhate (cck: ka.)
dhp374:4:
vijānataṁ → yato yato samaṣati bandhana udayavaya. 
labhati priti pramoju amutū ta vijanatu (bj: prā. dha. B . 17)
dhp375:4:
saṁvaro → tatrai adi bhavati tadha prañasa bhikhuno 
idriyagoti satuṭhi pratimukhei (bj: prā. dha. B . 17)
dhp376:3: paṭisanthāravutyassa → paṭisanthāravutt assa (pts) | Paṭisanthāravutyassa → paṭisandhāravutyassa (cck: ka.)
dhp376:6:
karissati → karissasi (bj) | karissasi → mitra bhayea paḍiruva sudhasīva a.... 
paḍisaravuti asa aprak...... 
datu ayarakuśalo suhu bhikhu vihaṣisi (bj: prā. dha. B . 18)
dhp377:2: maddavāni → majjavāni (cck: ka. ṭīkā); paccavāni (cck: ka. aṭṭha.)
dhp378:2: santavā → santamano (sya-all) | susamāhito → santamano susamāhito (cck: syā. pī.); santamano samāhito (cck: ka.)
dhp379:1: codayattānaṁ paṭimaṁsetha → coday attānaṁ paṭimāse attam (pts)
dhp379:2: paṭimaṁsetha attanā → paṭimaṁsetamattanā (sya-all) | attanā → paṭimāse attamattanā (cck: sī. pī.); paṭimaṁse tamattanā (cck: syā.)
dhp380:4: saṁyamamattānaṁ → saññamayattānaṁ (bj); saññama attānaṁ (sya-all); saññāmay attānaṁ (pts) | saṁyamamattānaṁ → saṁyamaya’ttānaṁ (cck: sī. pī.)
dhp381:4:
sukhaṁ → pramojabahulu yo bhikhu abhivuyu paripriya 
adhikachi pada śata aseyana moyaka. (prā. dha. B . 31) 
(aseyana = asecanakaṁ) 
(moyaka = mocakaṁ) (bj note)
dhp382:3: somaṁ → so imaṁ (bj, sya-all) | Somaṁ → so imaṁ (cck: sī. syā. kaṁ. pī.)
